methods.what: Criterion: if the integral μ²∫ Fx λx cos μ(x−ξ)dx vanishes for every interval, the Fourier coefficients tend to zero and convergence at x depends only on the function's behaviour in an arbitrarily small neighbourhood of x (localization)
methods.quote:

mit wachsendem n unendlich klein und in der Summe der
n ersten Glieder wird der Einfluss aller Grössenintervalle
wenn n unendlich gross wird, unendlich klein

items.english: It therefore depends only on the behaviour of the function in the infinitely near neighbourhood of this value whether the series converges or not.

items.english: then the constants a_n, b_n do not become infinitely small as n grows; a finite bound can be given such that however far one goes in the series, coefficients larger than this bound must still occur.
